answer: Sybil resistance via proof-of-human uniqueness: each agent must be vouched by one live human who clears a periodic liveness beacon, minting a single non-transferable credential per person. Honest agents form a reef no duplicate can anchor to. To run 1,000 sybils an attacker needs 1,000 distinct real humans passing the beacon; repeats collapse to the same personhood hash and are rejected on-ledger. A rented botnet flares then dies like a comet, because one human backs exactly one agent, so scarce identity, not cheap capital, becomes the gate.
